teachingReview.heading: Find acute illness
teachingReview.body: Infection, myocardial infarction, stroke, pancreatitis, surgery, trauma, and other stressors raise counterregulatory hormones and can reduce intake. Evaluation should follow symptoms, examination, risk, and initial data.
teachingReview.review: Original body retained. Full precipitant lists, modern mixed-crisis thresholds/insulin rate, IV overlap or complete discharge/access plan require further reconciliation; partial book support does not establish the whole body.

teachingReview.heading: Find treatment and access failures
teachingReview.body: New diabetes, insufficient insulin, glucocorticoids, sympathomimetics, atypical antipsychotics, thiazide-like diuretics, enteral or parenteral nutrition, and limited access to water or diabetes care can contribute.
teachingReview.review: Original body retained. Full precipitant lists, modern mixed-crisis thresholds/insulin rate, IV overlap or complete discharge/access plan require further reconciliation; partial book support does not establish the whole body.

teachingReview.heading: Recognize mixed DKA and HHS
teachingReview.body: Significant ketonemia at least 3.0 mmol/L or metabolic acidosis indicates mixed DKA and HHS rather than pure HHS. Mixed crisis uses the higher 0.1 units/kg/h DKA insulin intensity after potassium safety is established.
teachingReview.review: Original body retained. Full precipitant lists, modern mixed-crisis thresholds/insulin rate, IV overlap or complete discharge/access plan require further reconciliation; partial book support does not establish the whole body.

teachingReview.heading: Transition without an insulin gap
teachingReview.body: Select subcutaneous therapy from prior treatment, inpatient requirements, nutrition, kidney function, hypoglycemia risk, and the reason for HHS. Give basal insulin with protocol-defined overlap before stopping IV insulin when ongoing insulin is required.
teachingReview.review: Original body retained. Full precipitant lists, modern mixed-crisis thresholds/insulin rate, IV overlap or complete discharge/access plan require further reconciliation; partial book support does not establish the whole body.

teachingReview.heading: Correct the system that failed
teachingReview.body: Treat infection or vascular disease, reassess hyperglycemia-promoting medicines, confirm insulin and device technique, and evaluate whether thirst, mobility, cognition, caregiving, food, housing, cost, or transportation limited care.
teachingReview.review: Original body retained. Full precipitant lists, modern mixed-crisis thresholds/insulin rate, IV overlap or complete discharge/access plan require further reconciliation; partial book support does not establish the whole body.

teachingReview.heading: Match inpatient insulin to oral intake
teachingReview.body: After acute-crisis stabilization, reassess the inpatient insulin regimen as oral intake changes. The book prefers basal, prandial and correction insulin when oral intake is adequate, and basal plus correction insulin when oral intake is poor. Correction doses reflect the individual patient's insulin sensitivity; sliding-scale insulin alone is strongly discouraged. These oral-intake principles do not specify an enteral-feed dosing schedule or the timing of IV-to-subcutaneous insulin overlap.
teachingReview.review: Oral-intake regimen teaching and distinction between patient-specific correction and sliding scale alone are source-supported. The post-crisis placement is a teaching-context synthesis; no acute HHS or enteral-feed dosing policy added.

teachingReview.heading: Create a usable prevention plan
teachingReview.body: Provide written glucose, medication, hydration, sick-day, emergency, and contact instructions. Ensure medicines, monitoring supplies, water access, caregiver support when needed, and early outpatient follow-up are available before discharge.
teachingReview.review: Original body retained. Full precipitant lists, modern mixed-crisis thresholds/insulin rate, IV overlap or complete discharge/access plan require further reconciliation; partial book support does not establish the whole body.
